open_chat.description: Open Gemini Web or an existing conversation by ID in this Chrome session. Return only the current chat ID.

type_prompt.description: Type text into the empty Gemini composer. This action leaves the prompt as a draft.

click.description: Click a mapped Gemini control. For Deep Research, clarify the topic if the conversation does not supply one. After Send, use read_result in the same session. For video delivery, use download_video and attach the returned verified file. Start research only when requested and the current plan offers confirmation.

select_model.description: Open the Gemini model picker if needed and click the option matching its exact visible label.

read_result.description: Return the latest visible text response in this Gemini chat, up to 4,000 characters. Return running while Gemini is responding.

inspect.description: Inspect Gemini Web or open an existing chat in the selected Chrome profile. Return the chat ID, active account, model, visible controls, and any displayed usage-limit or reset information.

chat.description: Optional existing Gemini conversation ID, with or without the c_ prefix.

reply.description: Send one text follow-up in an existing Gemini chat. Provide a portable continuation checkpoint to enable handoff after confirmed pre-send model quota exhaustion. Reuse the job or original request ID to recover an unconfirmed result.

chat.description: Existing Gemini conversation ID returned by inspect.

request_id.description: Unique ID for this follow-up. Keep it for retries and reconciliation.

continuation.description: Optional context you authorize the destination account to receive.

model.description: Exact model label shown by inspect.

checkpoint.description: Complete portable text context needed to continue the task.
